title: Guest letter
description: A letter to guests or passengers from a ship or property: an illness notice, cabin isolation instructions, an itinerary or port change, a compensation offer, a shelter-in-place notice or a service outage notice. It names the real steps guests take, gives a contact, and offers no medical advice beyond cited guidance.

examples: Calloway Cruise Line · MV Harbor Lantern

dateLine.description: Date and time of the letter

examples: We want you to know that some guests and crew have had stomach illness during this voyage.

steps.description: What guests are asked to do, one step each
examples: Wash your hands with soap and water often, especially before eating.
If you feel ill, call the medical center at 4-1000 and stay in your cabin.

whatWeAreDoing.description: What the operator is doing, one line each
examples: Increased cleaning and disinfection of public areas

offer.description: Compensation or rebooking offer, if the letter makes one
examples: Every guest on this voyage receives a 25 percent credit toward a future cruise.
Guest Services desk, Deck 5, open 24 hours · cabin phone 4-2000
Captain Elias Brandt, Master; Maren Okoye, Hotel Director
